svg.text: “They're 50 basis points lower than last May.”
— what ‘Rates are still high. I'll wait.’ usually means

Freddie Mac 30-year fixed: 6.36% as of May 14 — versus 6.86% a year ago. On a $600,000 loan, that's $181 per month lower. Real shift in affordability. The news cycle moved on, but the rate did not move back up — it kept drifting lower while everyone was watching prices.
